requirement: GET /profiles may only be accessed by the Owner (privileged) user; requests by other users are denied.
label: GAP
evidence: The GET /profiles handler in the `profiles()` function calls `validate_token()` to check authentication, but after that it does not check `auth_data['privileged']` at all before returning results.
reasoning: The requirement states that GET /profiles may only be accessed by the Owner (privileged) user and other users must be denied. The code validates the token but never checks whether the authenticated user has `privileged=True`. Any authenticated user, privileged or not, will receive the full list of profiles. A test sending a non-privileged user's token to GET /profiles would receive a 200 response instead of a 401/403 denial, so the requirement is entirely absent.
